name: VQA v2.0: Visual Question Answering with Balanced Pairings
description: VQA v2.0 is the premier visual question answering benchmark featuring complementary image-question pairs explicitly balanced to minimize language bias. For every question, the dataset contains pairs of similar images resulting in different answers, forcing multimodal models to ground reasoning in visual perception. Built upon 204,721 MS-COCO images, it contains 1,105,904 open-ended questions and over 11 million answers.
